answer_blocks.question: Does Nimbus Notes work offline?
answer_blocks.answer: Yes. Nimbus Notes stores every note on your device first and syncs when a connection returns.

answer_blocks.question: Can I export my notes?
answer_blocks.answer: Yes. Settings → Export produces a folder of Markdown files at any time, on every plan.

answer_blocks.question: Where is my data stored?
answer_blocks.answer: In the EU (Frankfurt) by default. Enterprise plans can choose a region.
